text: The FSOC relied most heavily on some of the most problematic disclosure items the SEC collects, even though SEC data played a crucial role at every stage of its systemic risk assessment of private funds.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Investment Fund Regulation - Theory and Empirical Evidence from 1998 to 2016 (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998097

isBasedOn.name: Private Investment Fund Regulation - Theory and Empirical Evidence from 1998 to 2016

abstract: The author showed that while the SEC's data played a crucial role in all stages of FSOC's systemic risk assessment of private funds, the FSOC relied most heavily on some of the most problematic disclosure items collected by the SEC.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: FSOC systemic risk assessment of private funds
